meta.title: Scanix — Automated Security Testing
meta.description: Professional security testing for SMEs. Automated, fast and affordable. Report within 10 minutes.

hero.subtitle: Scanix automatically tests your systems for vulnerabilities and delivers a professional report within 10 minutes — at a fraction of the cost of a manual pentest.

problem.title: Why this matters
problem.card1Label: average cost of a manual pentest
problem.card2Subtext: have never had a security test performed
problem.card3Subtext: that is how long a breach stays unnoticed
problem.paragraph: Large companies have security teams and annual pentests. SMEs do not. Scanix makes professional security testing accessible to every business — automated, fast and affordable.

how.title: Three steps to insight
how.step1Text: Enter the address of your website or server. We verify that the system is yours and start the test.
how.step2Text: 15 professional tools run automatically. The same tools real hackers use — now working for your protection.
how.step3Text: Within 10 minutes you get a complete report with a risk score, findings by severity, and a concrete remediation plan. PDF and NIS2 report included.

what.title: What Scanix checks
what.subtitle: 17 automated tests in a single scan
what.card1Text: Mapping open ports, services and version information
what.card2Text: Detecting known CVEs and weak configurations
what.card3Text: SQL injection, directory traversal and missing security headers
what.card4Text: Brute-force attacks on SSH, FTP and web logins
what.card6Text: All results are analysed by AI and translated into an easy-to-understand report
what.more: Attack simulation, Proof of risk, Cloud security check and more

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.s1Body: Scanix may only be used to test systems that you demonstrably own or for which you have received written permission from the owner.
terms.s2Body: It is strictly forbidden to use Scanix to test systems without permission, to carry out attacks, or for any other illegal purpose.
terms.s3Body: Scanix and its developers are not liable for any damage arising from the use of the platform. The user is fully responsible for all actions carried out through the platform.
terms.s4Body: To run scans, you must be able to demonstrate ownership or permission. Scanix reserves the right to block accounts on suspicion of misuse.
terms.s5Body: By using Scanix, you agree to these terms.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1Body: We only process the data needed to perform a security test: the specified system address, your contact details and the results of the scan.
privacy.s2Body: All your data is stored exclusively on servers within the European Union. Your data never leaves the EU.
privacy.s3Body: Scan results are automatically deleted after 90 days, unless you request otherwise.
privacy.s4Body: You have the right to access, correct and delete your data. To do so, contact us at privacy@scanix.nl.
privacy.s5Body: For questions about privacy, you can contact us at privacy@scanix.nl.
